query_text: Create a heatmap with value-chain segments on rows and funding-stage families on columns, where each cell shows the average `Mosaic score` for companies in that segment-stage combination, using stage-family normalization such as `equity VC`, `debt/loan/credit`, `grant/corporate`, and `N/A/other`, and include only cells with at least two companies.
sort_rule: report segment order on rows; normalized stage-family order on columns
selection_rule: cells with at least two companies

plot_config.title: Average Mosaic by segment and normalized stage family

reasoning_summary: Assigned segment membership from section-2 boundaries.
Normalized raw stage labels into equity VC, debt/loan/credit, grant/corporate, and N/A/other.
Aggregated average Mosaic by segment-stage cell.
Excluded cells with fewer than two companies.
open_issues: Stage-family mapping is a documented normalization step rather than a visible source field.
